change_log.summary: Improve CLAR retrieval by synthesizing focused review responses with single LLM call
details: Diagnosis: The memory read returned raw stored records only, which left downstream reviewers to synthesize relevance and actionable guidance themselves. This caused ambiguous, fragmented CLAR outputs and extra cognitive load; reviewers repeatedly requested concise pseudocode, notation tables, and figure/axis clarifications that the memory could have highlighted.

Specific change: Enhance KnowledgeBase.read to assemble a concise, reviewer-focused prompt (including INSTRUCTION_* guidance and up to 8 stored records) and make a single controlled call to toolkit.llm_completion to synthesize a directly usable CLAR-style summary and targeted action items. Added fallback formatting if LLM is unavailable. Keep one LLM call per read and cap output to 3000 characters.

change_log.summary: Clarify notation and include schema context in memory summaries
details: Diagnosis: Reviews and traces show recurring clarity issues around notation (e.g., token ordering, 3ℓ-1), missing explicit mapping of symbols, and reliance on an appendix Algorithm 1. These reduce reproducibility and burden the reviewer.

Change: Add a compact notation helper and include a concise notation/table in the LLM prompt so read() returns context-aware CLAR-focused summaries that explicitly mention relevant symbols and where Algorithm 1 / pseudocode are referenced.

change_log.summary: Add notation table and sharpen LLM prompt for focused CLAR summaries
details: Diagnosis: The query-to-LLM prompt lacked a compact notation/context helper and explicit instructions to request exact locations (section/eq/figure) and concise actionable fixes, reducing clarity and reproducibility of generated CLAR summaries.

Change: Add a small notation table helper and include it in the LLM prompt; strengthen instructions to ask for exact locations, concrete fixes, and bounded-length output. Ensure robust fallback behavior.

change_log.summary: Clarify reviewer prompt and include compact notation context for LLM summaries
details: Diagnosis: Reviewer memories sometimes produced under-specified or unfocused summaries; LLM prompts lacked grounded notation and concise reviewer guidance, making CLAR outputs less actionable and reproducible.

Specific change: Added a compact notation/context block and tightened the LLM prompt to explicitly request short, actionable CLAR-style summaries. Also improved memory selection and fallback formatting to ensure deterministic, at-most-one-LLM-call behavior and outputs within 3000 characters.
